items.text: Promising - although there should be an auto pilot for say keeping your ship in orbit about a station or simple journeys. Currently you switch it on only for far trips and even then its a bit dodgy - the future should have figured out stuff we have already now.
items.text_zh: 很有前途——不过应该有一个自动驾驶功能，比如说让你的飞船保持在某个空间站周围的轨道上，或者进行简单航行。目前你只能在长途旅行时开启它，而且即便如此也有点不靠谱——未来本该已经搞明白我们现在就已经有的东西。

observations.evidence: Currently you switch it on only for far trips and even then its a bit dodgy
observations.evidence_zh: 目前你只在长途旅行时才开启它，而且即便如此也有点不太靠谱
